evidence.decision: The Census county-change pages are stored as reference documents of the existing ADJ source. One Python reader turns their pinned change lists into the reviewed dbt seed census_county_change_events. The warehouse never parses the pages.
evidence.listing: Direct URL in the dotted form linked by the Census index page. The response must be HTTP 200 text/html with the decade heading and a parsed change list, because an unrelated Census path can also return an HTML page.
